blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: History for SSC exams is broadly divided into Ancient, Medieval, and Modern Indian History.
Indus Valley Civilisation and the Vedic Period form the foundation of Ancient Indian History.
Delhi Sultanate (1206–1526 AD) and the Mughal Empire (1526–1857 AD) form the core of Medieval Indian History.
Modern History focuses heavily on the Indian Freedom Struggle, the Indian National Congress (1885), and British constitutional developments.
